data.name: Green Carbon Products
data.description: Green Carbon Products is a small Ontario company that makes biochar from 100% sustainably sourced clean wood and sells it as a soil and compost amendment priced in CAD. They also offer wood mass reduction services. There is no evidence of carbon credit issuance, registry participation, or involvement in the compliance/voluntary CDR market — operations appear to be a small retail biochar business.
